title: How the World Works: Economy & Governance

questions.prompt: Civics, for Crenshaw in this lecture, includes more than formal government—also:
choices: B How the world and economy work and how goods get from farm to store.
questions.explain: He widens civics to economy, history, and everyday logistics.

questions.prompt: Congressional earmarks, in his account, were banned roughly:
questions.explain: He notes the 2010–2021 earmark ban after public outcry.

questions.prompt: Every five years Congress authorizes the farm bill, whose functions include:

questions.explain: Farm bill authorization includes crop insurance.
